title: maint.event.v1{kind=manual_scale_pin}
description: Phase 8 §8.2 — operator pins a target replica count on a scalable agent. Pin expires after `cfg.maint_scaler_manual_pin_ttl_s`; an early `manual_scale_pin` with `replicas=-1` cancels.

target.description: Agent id (e.g. predictor.elo.v1) or worker class.

replicas.description: Desired replica count; -1 cancels an active pin.

ttl_s.description: Override default pin TTL; 0 means use cfg default.
